mapper.insert: insert into gf_gacha_ranking_list(user_id, luck_value, total_draws) values (#{userId}, #{luckValue}, #{totalDraws})

insert.foreach: insert into gf_gacha_ranking_list(user_id, luck_value, total_draws) values (#{userId}, #{luckValue}, #{totalDraws})

mapper.update: update gf_gacha_ranking_list set is_deleted = 1 where user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select r.luck_value, r.total_draws, u.uid as userId from gf_gacha_ranking_list as r left join gf_user as u on r.user_id = u.id where r.is_deleted = 0 order by r.luck_value desc limit 1000
